headline: Petrobras Raises Aviation Kerosene Prices by 7.2% in Brazil
summary: Petrobras announced a 7.2% increase in aviation kerosene prices, or R$0.45 per liter, reflecting higher international fuel prices driven by Middle East tensions and the Russia-Ukraine war.
why: Petrobras is Brazil's state-controlled oil producer and the dominant domestic supplier of aviation fuel, directly determining airline operating costs across Latin America's largest economy.

impacts.name: Petrobras
impacts.why: Raising domestic aviation fuel prices improves Petrobras's downstream realizations.
